steps.text: Pick up the strange egg from the Goren Egg treasure in Gorgrond.
Keep the egg while it incubates for seven days, then take the hatched Goren Garb.
steps.details: The source reports a seven-day transformation. Show a ready estimate only when Toybox observed acquisition; an old egg’s starting time is unknown. The toy still requires learning.

steps.text: Use Goren Garb from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
At the tree, pick up Loose Soil and throw it into the branches to knock down the strange fruit.
Keep the strange fruit for fourteen days. Once ripe, open it and take the Podling Camouflage toy.
steps.details: A timer is an estimate based on observed fruit acquisition; it never substitutes for actual item receipt.

steps.text: Use Podling Camouflage from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Vial of Red Goo

steps.text: Use Drained Blood Crystals on the Blood Moon until its health reaches zero, revealing the Remnant of the Blood Moon.
Defeat the Remnant of the Blood Moon and loot for Vial of Red Goo.
Use Vial of Red Goo from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: Required Drained Blood Crystal acquisition and item identifier are not established by this source.

steps.text: Eat the nearby Mysterious Fruit until you gain Pollen Protection, then collect The Perfect Blossom.
steps.details: A chest tracking flag is not an accepted quest. Pollen Protection must be observed in game; its aura ID is not specified by the pinned source.

steps.text: Use The Perfect Blossom from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Speak to Skoller and take his Bag of Squirrel Treats.
Use Skoller's Bag of Squirrel Treats from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Enter the Legerdemain Lounge and take the stairs to the upper floor.
Collect the Wand of Simulated Life from the upstairs table.
Use Wand of Simulated Life from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Legion Communication Orb

steps.text: Run through all three runes around the summoning site to call Doomsayer Suprax.
Defeat Doomsayer Suprax and loot for the communication orb. If his fatal debuff is about to expire, step into a Doom Star to clear it.
steps.details: The source says the debuff bypasses immunities. No duration or spawn countdown is assumed.

steps.text: Use Legion Communication Orb from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Argus introduction and Antoran Wastes access chain beginning with The Hand of Fate (quest47221) is not authored here.

routes.title: Sightless Eye

steps.text: For a personal route, obtain an Observer’s Locus Resonator from Orix the All-Seer for 500 Intact Demon Eyes. Another player’s portal is an alternative.
steps.details: A shared portal does not require purchasing your own resonator. Toybox never buys or uses transport items automatically.

steps.text: Use the resonator or an available shared portal to reach the Observer’s Locus platform.
Defeat and loot Rezira the Seer for a chance at the Sightless Eye.
Use Sightless Eye from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Argus introduction and Antoran Wastes access chain beginning with The Hand of Fate (quest47221) is not authored here.
Intact Demon Eye farming is supplied by the separate All-Seer’s Eye route; transport use remains an observed/manual step.

routes.title: S.F.E. Interceptor

steps.text: Defeat the demons on the Terminus docks and ship until you obtain a Smashed Portal Generator.
With the broken generator collected, continue defeating the Terminus demons for its other three components.
steps.details: The other parts only begin dropping after the Smashed Portal Generator has been collected.

steps.text: Combine all four components into Vishax’s Portal Generator.
Use the assembled generator to begin the portal quest, power up the portal and follow it to Commander Vishax.
Defeat Commander Vishax and loot for the S.F.E. Interceptor.
Use S.F.E. Interceptor from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Argus introduction and Antoran Wastes access chain beginning with The Hand of Fate (quest47221) is not authored here.

routes.title: All-Seer's Eye

steps.text: Start at full health and activate an All-Seer Focus to become an Agent of the All-Seer. The focus removes ninety percent of your health, and nearby guards become unfriendly.
steps.details: The focus is a gameplay cost. Activate it yourself only when ready; Toybox does not click it.

steps.text: While the Agent of the All-Seer effect is active, defeat demons on Argus and collect 1,000 Intact Demon Eyes.
steps.details: If the effect expires, return to a focus. Eyes are observed inventory, not estimated from kills.

steps.text: Return to Orix the All-Seer and exchange 1,000 eyes for the All-Seer’s Eye toy.
Use All-Seer's Eye from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Argus introduction and Antoran Wastes access chain beginning with The Hand of Fate (quest47221) is not authored here.

steps.text: At the runebound chest, choose the directions in this order: Left, Right, Down, Up. Open the chest and take the Heartsbane Grimoire.
Use Heartsbane Grimoire from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
At the runebound chest, choose the directions in this order: Right, Up, Left, Down. Open the chest and take the Drust Ritual Knife.
Use Drust Ritual Knife from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Enter the cave and continue to the water at its back. Look overhead for the rare’s flight path.
Tag Shassera as she flies above the water, defeat her and loot for Shadescale.
Use Shadescale from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Pop five interactable Undisturbed Specimens around the summoning area. Other players’ contributions count toward the same spawn.
Defeat Tidemistress Leth’sindra when the specimens summon her, then loot for the warning sign.
Use Shirakess Warning Sign from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Pick up the Faerie Lamp in the northeast of Eventide Grove.
While the lamp’s effect is active, follow the path back southwest and open the Elusive Faerie Cache.
Use Fae Pipes from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Bring a second player to the Harmonic Chest. Have one person play the nearby harp while the other plays the drums to open it.
Open the unlocked Harmonic Chest and take the Fae Harp.
Use Fae Harp from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Start up the path at the marked point, then keep left toward the bridge.
Cross the bridge to the ledge above the treasure. Use the nearby feather for slow fall if needed.
Drop carefully onto the treasure’s branch and collect the Hearty Dragon Plume.
Use Hearty Dragon Plume from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Defeat enemies around the Eternal Forge. Listen to Forge-Keeper Mnemis’s announcements and continue until the threat level reaches Major, dispatching Aegeon.
Defeat Enforcer Aegeon and loot for the Ever-Abundant Hearth.
Use Ever-Abundant Hearth from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Get an Unstable Memory Fragment’s attention and pull it through other fragments until it reaches ten stacks of Instability and transforms.
steps.details: If the fragments are absent, this rare cannot currently be summoned. Do not invent a respawn timer.

steps.text: Defeat the transformed Unstable Memory and loot for the Mnemonic Attunement Pane.
Use Mnemonic Attunement Pane from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Stand in front of the Gift of Chyrus, kneel with /kneel, then open the treasure and take the diadem.
Use Bondable Val'kyr Diadem from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Take two Purians from the bench.
Place one Purian in the first tribute bowl.
Place the second Purian in the other tribute bowl.
Follow the trail of light and collect the Scroll of Aeons.
Use Scroll of Aeons from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Find a sparkling Noxious Moth in Mauler’s Outlook and click it to gain the Shardhide extra action.
Use the granted extra action to ride a Shardhide into the tree, knocking down the Precarious Silk Nest.
Open the fallen nest and take the Silver Shardhide Whistle.
Use Silver Shardhide Whistle from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
From the marked launch point, use a Goblin Glider or another available safe route to reach the island.
steps.details: Toybox never activates a glider automatically. Do not assume a character has one.

steps.text: Collect the Forgotten Feather on the island.
Use Forgotten Feather from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Pick up the Empty Plague Bottle from the table next to the vat.
With the bottle collected, click the vat of slime and take the Phial of Ravenous Slime.
Use Phial of Ravenous Slime from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Pick up the sparkling Remnants of Light scattered through the Ember Ward. Use their extra action on nearby ghouls or outcasts until a ghoul’s shout announces Sire Ladinas.
Defeat Sire Ladinas and loot for Smolderheart.
Use Smolderheart from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Click the fishing rod at the marked fishing spot to call Muckribbon.
Defeat Muckribbon and loot the reward for the Bat Visage Bobber.
Use Bat Visage Bobber from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Take the stairs starting at the marked point and follow them up toward the treasure.
Collect the Stylish Black Parasol at the top.
Use Stylish Black Parasol from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Use the Ingress and Egress Rites at the marked point to reveal the hidden chest.
While the rites’ effect is active, open the revealed chest and take the Bondable Sinstone.
Use Bondable Sinstone from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
At Catalyst Wards, activate all four switches: behind the entrance lock, in the southwest room, in the southern room with the guardian, and in the southeast room. This powers the central teleporter.
steps.details: All four switches use NPC185390. The southern room contains NPC181652. Proximity does not prove interaction; use Continue after activating the switches.

steps.text: Use the activated central teleporter, then open the treasure for the Infested Automa Core.
Use Infested Automa Core from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.
Defeat enemies around the Sandworn chest area until you collect five Sandworn Chest Key Fragments.
Combine five fragments into a Sandworn Chest Key.
Find a Sandworn Chest at one of the marked sites, unlock it with the key and loot for Makaris’s Satchel of Mines.
Use Makaris's Satchel of Mines from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Investi-gator's Pocketwatch

steps.text: At the Everywhen Inn, go upstairs and borrow Melly’s Metronographer. Use it near Bartender Bob to reveal Bartender Blob.
Use Melly’s Metronographer near Bartender Bob downstairs. Buy Infinitea from the revealed Bartender Blob only when ready; it expires after thirty seconds.
Reach the waterfall before the Infinitea expires, drink it, then interact with the newly visible Time-Soaked Clock to summon the rare.
Defeat the summoned rare and loot for the Investi-gator’s Pocketwatch.
Use Investi-gator's Pocketwatch from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: Required quest75986 and its prerequisite chain (76552, then74476 or74942, then75966) are not authored in this route.

steps.text: Check that Patient Vaargo and The Great Shellkhan are present before collecting the fish. You can activate this delivery once per character per week.
When ready, pick up a Case of Fresh Gleamfish from Kauriq Gleamlet in the Azure Span. Deliver it within three minutes.
Return the case to Patient Vaargo within three minutes to activate The Great Shellkhan.
Defeat The Great Shellkhan and loot for The Super Shellkhan Gang.
Use The Super Shellkhan Gang from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Silver Linin' Scepter

steps.text: Board the patrolling airship and speak with Sky-Captain Aerthin. These pins mark its patrol, not a stationary landing point.
Board the patrolling airship and speak with Sky-Captain Clairmonte. These pins mark its patrol, not a stationary landing point.
Board the patrolling airship and speak with Sky-Captain Dornald. These pins mark its patrol, not a stationary landing point.
Board the patrolling airship and speak with Sky-Captain Onaro. These pins mark its patrol, not a stationary landing point.
After meeting all four captains, dive to the Sunken Cache and open it for the Silver Linin’ Scepter.
Use Silver Linin' Scepter from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.details: The four captain checkpoints are a verified all-of requirement, not an inferred unordered quest chain.

steps.text: Speak to Freysworn Letitia and take the Crab-Guiding Branch.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab at the marked location and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab at the marked location and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab at the marked location and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab at the marked location and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab at the marked location and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Find the Pearlescent Shellcrab on the tree branch and use the Crab-Guiding Branch to guide it.
Return to Freysworn Letitia after guiding all six crabs and open the Tree’s Treasure for Hanna’s Locket.
Use Hanna's Locket from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Sovereign's Finery Chest

steps.text: Search the nearby Buried Treasure for the key to the Sovereign’s Finery Chest.
Use the key to unlock the Sovereign’s Finery Chest and take the toy.
Use Sovereign's Finery Chest from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: This source does not identify the prerequisite Buried Treasure object or its precise location; key acquisition needs that final factual lookup.

routes.title: Idol of Blue Water and Blue Sky

steps.text: Fish a Grisly Morsel from the Grisly Cod Pool.
Feed the morsel to the Hungry Dolphin so it accompanies you underwater. Stay submerged while it helps you search.
With the dolphin accompanying you, search the first underwater site for a half of the key.
Stay underwater and search the second site for the other key half.
Combine both key halves into the completed key.
Unlock the underwater treasure with the completed key and take the idol.
Use Idol of Blue Water and Blue Sky from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Coiled Isle introduction and underwater access prerequisites are not authored here; the puzzle itself is fully described.

routes.title: Pearl of Jubilation

steps.text: Search the Bubbling Clams underwater south of Nacretta’s cave until you obtain a Luminescent Pearl.
Enter the cave and present the pearl to Nacretta. Wait for the exchange before looking for the dropped key.
Pick up the key Nacretta drops.
Use the key on the nearby chest and take the Pearl of Jubilation.
Use Pearl of Jubilation from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Coiled Isle introduction and cave-access prerequisites are not authored here; the pearl exchange is fully described.

routes.title: Forgotten Memento

steps.text: Speak to the Forgotten Soldier and read the Nameless Grave before following the story into the Ring of Glory.
Speak to Zuzan, seated across from the Ring of Glory vendors.
Climb to Zan’ja on the Defiant Ring pillar and speak to him.
Speak to Ru’ko, meditating on an arch above the Ring of Glory.
Return to the Nameless Grave and collect the Forgotten Memento.
Use Forgotten Memento from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Coiled Isle introduction is not authored. The source supplies no individual dialogue checkpoint flags, so these interactions use cursor Continue until reward evidence is observed.

routes.title: Ancient Amani Mask

steps.text: Defeat Glittering Grouper Brinetails at the marked underwater sites until you have three Diver’s Key Fragments.
Combine the three fragments into a Diver’s Key.
Use the key on the submerged treasure and collect the Ancient Amani Mask.
Use Ancient Amani Mask from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: The Coiled Isle introduction and underwater access prerequisites are not authored here.

routes.title: Lava Fountain

steps.text: Stand facing the board with your back to Puzzlemaster Lo. Label its five rows left-to-right A–E, F–J, K–O, P–T and U–Y.
For level 1, activate these board positions: A, E, M, U, Y. Confirm the board has advanced before continuing.
For level 2, activate these board positions: C, K, M, O, W. Confirm the board has advanced before continuing.
For level 3, activate these board positions: B, K, L, O, V. Confirm the board has advanced before continuing.
For level 4, activate these board positions: A, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, O, Q, S, W. Confirm the board has advanced before continuing.
For level 5, activate these board positions: D, E, F, G, I, J, K, L, M, Q, R, S, U, W, X. Confirm the board has advanced before continuing.
After completing all five levels, open Puzzlemaster Lo’s chest and take the Lava Fountain.
Use Lava Fountain from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: Shaman class-hall introduction and access to the Maelstrom order hall are not authored here. The five puzzle levels have observed hidden completion flags41071–41075.
